purpose: Capture inbound contact requests (no real backend)

constraints.note: formBehavior is locked to local-simulation-no-network: src/pages/Contact.jsx:28-30 resolves a local setTimeout, never a network request -- a generated PageSpec must not imply a real POST endpoint

responsive.phone: Form and headline stack full-width, tight bottom padding.
responsive.tablet: Bottom padding grows substantially (tablet:pb-[220px]); headline/form column caps at 480px (tablet:max-w-[480px]); heading steps to tablet:text-title-t.
responsive.desktop: Padding becomes uniform on all sides (desktop:p-40, replacing the phone/tablet's asymmetric top/bottom values); heading steps to desktop:text-title with desktop:text-body-l.
